notes: Read SKILL.md and references/dast-tools.md in full. The skill covers dynamic application security testing of a running web app or API with OWASP ZAP (Docker baseline/full/API scans, automation framework), Burp Suite's REST API, Nikto, Nuclei, CI integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab), a security-header check and OWASP Top 10 finding categories.

Medium: following it has the agent pull and run scanner containers, apt-get install nikto, `go install` nuclei@latest, and send active scan traffic (spidering, active scans, XSS/SQLi test inputs) to a target URL, optionally with test login credentials. Acceptable because it is defensive assessment guidance whose prerequisites require testing authorization (SKILL.md:27) and that recommends staging over production (SKILL.md:386, references/dast-tools.md:101); the agent should only scan targets the user owns or is authorized to test.

Users should know: the ZAP daemon example (SKILL.md:46-52) binds the API on 0.0.0.0 and allows all addresses, so restrict it outside a local test box; reference examples use the deprecated owasp/zap2docker-stable image; `target.example.com`/`target.com` and the credentials (user/pass, password123, api-key) are placeholders. Related Skills (SKILL.md:397-399) link to sibling skills ../sast-scanning/, ../../operations/penetration-testing/, ../../network/waf-setup/ as optional reading only.
